title: About Levels Academy — Vake & Krtsanisi, Tbilisi
description: Founded in 2018. 600+ learners/year, small groups, international standards. Meet our team and student work.
blocks: About Levels Academy — Vake & Krtsanisi, Tbilisi

Founded in 2018, Levels Academy is a modern learning space in Tbilisi with two locations and a growing community of students. We teach kids, teens, adults, and corporate teams through structured programs that focus on real progress, confidence, and practical skills.
Alongside our English programs, Levels Art Academy offers drawing courses led by practicing artists, with creative projects and annual exhibition opportunities.

Levels Academy offers study abroad guidance for students who want to continue their education overseas. We help you choose the right program and pathway, understand the key steps, and prepare with clarity so the process feels simple and manageable.

Our summer school programs abroad are a chance to combine learning and adventure. Students improve their English in a real international classroom, make new friends from around the world, and return home with stronger confidence, fresh motivation, and unforgettable memories.

Levels Academy is proud to announce that we are now an official Cambridge English Educational Partner. This recognition confirms that our teaching standards, courses and learning environment meet the quality requirements set by Cambridge.

Through this partnership, our students benefit from Cambridge-aligned programs, official resources and a clear pathway to internationally recognized Cambridge English Qualifications, helping them achieve strong, practical results in English.

Ani holds a bachelor’s in Law from TSU and has worked in courts, a law firm, and private companies, as well as in quality management. At Levels Academy (since 2022), she contributes to a well-organized, student-centred learning environment.

Olga graduated in Arabic Studies from Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University and holds a Cambridge CELTA certificate. She has taught English abroad to learners from kindergarten through secondary school and has professional experience as a consecutive interpreter.

Ia holds a degree from the Apolon Kutateladze Tbilisi State Academy of Arts. She lectures in Interior Design at the Academy and also teaches at Fokani Workshops. Her work has been shown in dozens of exhibitions.

Jasmine is a South African English instructor at Levels Academy. She completed her studies at Northern Caucasus Federal University and the National Technical University of Ukraine, and brings international experience, having taught English across multiple countries.

Carrie is an American instructor at Levels Academy. She holds an MA in Linguistics from the University of London and additional degrees in Agriculture and Fashion Design. Since 2014, she has taught English in both public and private schools and has worked as an academic translator and editor.

Kristine has taught English since 2019, working with both children and adults. She blends a communicative approach with clear grammar support, tailoring lessons to different levels. Experienced in group and one-to-one formats, she fosters a calm, motivating classroom.

Mariam is an English instructor at Levels Academy. Recognized as a winner of multiple international competitions and programs, she brings a high standard of excellence to her teaching. She fosters a supportive, results-oriented classroom and helps learners build confidence and clear, measurable progress.

Faith Yongama Gwaza is our English teacher with many years of experience in international educational projects. She holds a certificate from the World TESOL Academy, which enables her to teach English as a foreign language effectively. She collaborates with organizations such as Network Without Borders, where she helps children develop their communication skills.

Elene is an English instructor at Levels Academy. She holds a BA in English Philology and an MA in Translation and Intercultural Relations. Drawing on her background in linguistics and cross-cultural communication, she designs clear, structured lessons that build accuracy, fluency, and cultural awareness.

Lana holds a BA in English Philology from Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University and an MA in Linguistics from TSU and Ca’ Foscari University of Venice. She has taught English since 2022 across several schools, bringing a clear, student-centred approach that builds confidence and fluency.

Ana is an internationally educated professional with academic qualifications from universities in France, the Netherlands, Ireland, and Estonia. She brings extensive and diverse experience in English language instruction. Ana holds an internationally accredited IELTS C1 certification.

Khatuna Buskivadze is a CELTA-certified English language specialist and an associate professor at Caucasus University. She holds a BA in English Philology and a PhD in English Philology, Applied Linguistics and Sociolinguistics. Khatuna's competence and enthusiasm ensure that the programs at Levels Academy meet the highest standards.

Natali Shubitidze is an Art instructor at Levels Academy. Trained in Fine Arts, Printmaking, and Graphic Design at the Tbilisi State Academy of Arts and the Gdańsk Academy of Fine Arts (Poland), she brings extensive experience in both traditional and digital media. Natali has
completed professional apprenticeships in enamel painting and contributed to individual and collaborative projects.
